label: A mover moved in a relevant respect acts as an instrument
paraphrase: A mover other than what it moves that is being moved in a respect relevant to its moving of that thing does not move it by the power of its own form: it moves it as an instrument. Analyst formulation, open; restricted to the relevant respect, so weaker than STMT-WHATEVER-MOVES-AND-IS-MOVED-MOVES-AS-INSTRUMENT.
